report.summary: connection_pool_exhaustion in orders: deepest failing spans are in orders

hypotheses.reasoning: deepest failing spans are in orders

root_cause.summary: deepest failing spans are in orders

ground_truth.explanation: The external payment provider region eu1 became slow (median ~650ms). payments waits on it while orders holds pooled connections, so the pool also saturates; no internal change caused it.

changes.author: deploy-bot
changes.title: gateway: rebuild on patched base image
